- Thu Jul 8 — 11:00 AM
- Thu Jul 8 — 3:00 PM
- Fri Jul 9 — 10:00 AM

If none of those work, heres my calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/grace-30min — feel free to pick any open slot and it will auto-add Aditya.

- quick context + goals (5m)
- demo: routing, dedicated pools, and private deploy options (15m)
- next steps / pricing + timeline (10m)

Attachment: Redwood-OnePager.pdf (PDF, 450KB) — very high level.

Thanks — I can also do an initial discovery call if youd prefer that before the demo.
